notes: Corrected: כִּי אִם is fused into the single 'but' under rules 30 and 35, and the infinitival בְּ takes the complementizer 'that' under rule 52 instead of going unrepresented. The accepted split gave 'that' to אִם, which contributes no complementizer, and silenced a present preposition for which the ASV had written a word.
The oath 'As I live' is the formula's own rendering: the adjective takes 'As ... live' and אָנִי only its I (rule 55).
The head of the כִּי אִם unit is a genuine tie; it is taken on the opening conjunction, matching the treatment of אִם לֹא elsewhere in this chapter, and the alternative is named in the unit note.
